landed: A-bugs-7: spec.shape_problems(spec) checks container types (list keys, object keys, variants / phases as objects, +key appends a list, wrong plans with list plans) and check_structure returns them alone; behind them a guard turns any unreadable part or SpecError into a problem, so check_structure never raises and the compiler marks a malformed spec INVALID instead of aborting the catalog; merge raises SpecError for a non-list +key; L-ENVELOPE / L-PROTECT read malformed envelope / protections / protect_map parts as empty instead of 'could not be checked'

A-gaming-13: lint.invariant_problem / invariant_labels: an inv: expect pattern (L-EXPECT) or protect reference (L-PROTECT) names a whole invariant label (a registered name or a label a registered invariant returns literally, e.g. climate.pipe_freeze); inv:, inv:s, inv:people, inv:people.unwanted, inv:flag:fire are errors, so S0 stops such a spec; L-EXPECT also rejects unbound placeholders in patterns

A-spec-14: lint.selector_problem over lint.envelope_selectors (every selector and scope of envelope and protections): 6.6 forms per mode (selector / to / room / id), unknown <word>: forms are errors, placeholders bound by the setup (statically, or on every seed of the variant with the dynamic bindings), type: / is_a: registered types, unknown category: / tag: a warning, literal ids existing on every seed (new dynamic fact 'ids' from dynamic_facts via spec_literal_ids); L-PROTECT rule 2 resolves narrowed house: references the same way, checks field names and requires every placeholder of a reference to be bound

A-spec-12: docs name the landed WP5 and WP11 interfaces (KERNEL_API.md 'Verification core (WP5)' and 'Core skills (WP11)' with live signatures, including WP5-fix's new ones; EVALUATION.md 'Running it' and package status; EVAL_HARNESS.md; AUTHORING_GUIDE.md and TASK_SPEC.md CLI options; TASK_SPEC.md check_structure shape rule, inv: grammar, selector resolution, L-ESCAPE; KNOWN_LIMITS.md selector limits and the inv: label gap); only WP6 and WP10 remain listed as not landed

deviations.what: an unknown category: / tag: selector is a warning, not an error
deviations.why: domains may set tags at run time that the type registry does not list; unknown forms, unbound placeholders and unknown types are errors

deviations.what: literal ids and a scenario helper's bindings are checked only with dynamic facts (S8)
deviations.why: they cannot be known before a build; statically a literal id must only have the id form

deviations.why: the other checks would read a malformed part; fail-safe (INVALID with a named reason)
